The evidence is supported by the shared indication of Prednisone with Familial Glucocorticoid Deficiency, and the indirect link through Betamethasone, which is used in the treatment of Stevens-Johnson Syndrome, a condition associated with Prednisone. The scores from the paths indicate a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, though further research is needed to establish a direct causal link.
